cloudRun88Refresh.reportText:
Applied Codex Cloud run 88 unchanged in the five requested source files and merged the 1.16.0 main update. Final isolated runs printed 148 lines on main and 8 on the branch, with retention errors reduced from one to zero. Both launchers exited cleanly with no recorded children left running.

All 11 branch test files and all 9 files present on main passed: 316 branch tests and 312 main tests, with 29 and 29 existing skips. Fresh-source typecheck and ESLint passed. Every terminal line and earlier check outcome is retained in `evidence/clean-package-startup.json`.

One timing diagnostic still escapes: `[state transaction-hold]`, reporting a transaction hold of 103 ms. Its producer is `src/lib/state/sqliteStateStore.ts:581`; the Cloud filter at `bin/cli.mjs:209` handles only loop-gap and performance-summary prefixes. Extending that filter and the existing exposure fixture would depart from the instruction to apply the Cloud diff unchanged. Should the filter gain this prefix and its regression case (recommended), or should the exact Cloud patch remain with this limitation? The proposed hunk is recorded with the evidence.

transactionHoldFollowup.approvedAdjustment: Extend only the launcher timing-prefix filter and existing exposure fixture for state transaction-hold. The other Cloud source files retain the run-88 blobs.
transactionHoldFollowup.method: One gate-slot admission, sequential explicit test files, typecheck, ESLint, regression mutation, package builds, packs, isolated global installs and first runs. Tests use checkEnvironment and isolatedEnvironment with private HOME, XDG directories, LLV_STATE_DIR and TMPDIR. Temp directories use an open procfs directory alias into the private scratch area to keep fixture socket names within the Unix limit. Typecheck uses a clean source export, separate from both package-build exports, with a 6 GB Node heap. Packages are built with node scripts/prepack.mjs, packed with bun pm pack --ignore-scripts and installed with bun add -g --ignore-scripts --backend=copyfile. First runs use env -i, a free port, --no-open, telemetry disabled and a closed control URL; observe 65 seconds after HTTP readiness and the retention report, then send SIGINT and check recorded process identities.

hookEnvironmentRecovery.reportText:
A fresh package start prints 6 terminal lines, compared with 146 on the merged main revision. With telemetry disabled, ordinary startup prints the URL and installation/setup guidance and keeps progress and timing diagnostics out of the terminal. Debug and journal launches retain diagnostics, and real errors still print.

The fresh-install self-update error came from inspecting a release cache that does not exist yet. An absent cache now counts as empty; invalid roots still report errors. Codex Cloud run 88 supplied the fix. The approved transaction-hold filter remains in place. Exposure fixtures now isolate the gate service user bus and wait for the Viewer before probing.

All 11 core test files passed (316 tests; 29 existing skips). TypeScript and touched-file ESLint passed. The expanded comparison covered 80 branch files and 78 main files: 63 assertions fail identically on both sides, and four scheduling assertions varied across repeat samples. No persistent branch-only failure remains. Every file result, timing confirmation and terminal line is in evidence/clean-package-startup.json. Both clean launchers exited successfully with all recorded children gone. The merged main already suppresses the telemetry notice when DELEGATUS_TELEMETRY=0, so neither capture prints it.
